svg.title: Beat Sync snaps cuts to the beat of the music
svg.desc: Two timelines compared: cut points before Sync now are off the beat, after Sync now they sit on detected beats and bars
svg.text: Beat Sync snaps cuts to the beat of the music
The cuts fall between beats, so picture and music drift apart.
Amber lines are bar starts, grey lines are beats, round handles are the beat markers.
Schematic of a generic editor, not a screenshot of any product.
